name: Steam Workshop::VFX+
snippet: Dec 21, 2025 — The mod currently reworks the VFX (and often SFX too) of nearly every single Mage weapon , with other classes and changes coming in the future.

name: Weapon Visuals - Official Terraria Mods Wiki
snippet: Toggling the weapon visuals feature. The main feature of WeaponOut is to allow the player to have their weapons appear at all times, not just when in use.
